headlines.title: White House lawyer sends warning to House Democrats about potential investigations
headlines.description: White House counsel Will Scharf sent a letter to Rep. Robert Garcia, D-Calif., warning that his "abusive and capricious threats" to investigate the administration could be criminal. NBC News' Monica Alba has details on the letter and how Democrats are responding.

headlines.title: GOP Rep. María Elvira Salazar wins re-election in Florida after clashing with Trump
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Salazar defeated her Democratic opponent in a heavily Hispanic, Miami-based district that Trump carried by 15 points in 2024.

headlines.title: Measles cases explode amid declining vaccination rates
headlines.description: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin traveled to Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, which is the epicenter of a deadly measles outbreak. The investigative report for the NBC News series “The Vaccine Divide” finds 75% of U.S. counties have vaccination rates that are now below the level needed for herd immunity.

headlines.title: What are childhood vaccination rates in your community and schools?
headlines.description: This is part of The Vaccine Divide, an updated data investigation into America potentially losing its measles-free status as the deadly virus roars back and childhood vaccine defenses continue to crack and crumble.

headlines.title: Behind the data: How NBC News tracked the decline in childhood vaccinations
headlines.description: How an NBC News data investigation tracked vaccination and school exemption rates across thousands of counties in the U.S.

headlines.title: Biden faces protests during visit to Ireland
headlines.description: Former President Biden was met with protests while at Trinity College in Dublin, where his son Hunter was receiving an award. At least two people were arrested after throwing objects at the former president and his family as they entered their cars to leave the event.

headlines.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to large exchange of prisoners during peace talks
headlines.description: Russian, Ukrainian, and U.S. negotiators conclude their final day of U.S.-mediated peace talks in Abu Dhabi, their first face-to-face negotiations since February. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports on the latest developments, including potential agreements on prisoner exchanges and efforts to advance a broader peace deal.

headlines.title: Who is Alice Huang, the Woman at the Center of Nvidia Scandal?
headlines.description: Alice Huang, the woman at the center of a suspected spy scandal involving Nvidia’s CEO Jensen Huang, is a former tech executive who used to work for China’s state television, but now questions are being raised about how Alice and Jensen first met. NBC’s Janis Mackey Frayer reports from Beijing for TODAY.

headlines.title: U.S. charges 3 men with plotting multiple terror attacks, including on British air base
headlines.description: One of the men helped direct the planned attack against the air base while he was in a U.S. prison, according to a Justice Department indictment.

headlines.title: Ole Miss students ‘devastated’ by racist monkey gestures and noises captured on door camera
headlines.description: One of the women caught on camera making monkey noises and gestures at the apartment door of three Black Ole Miss students doubled down when confronted at the time, a woman who lives in the home told “CBS Morning.”

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Pete Hegseth and others reprimanded by guard at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth was reprimanded Wednesday by an Army sentinel guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier who asked him and his guests to maintain “atmospheric silence and respect.”
